operating_notes.text: ICRA enhanced rated facilities to ₹3,44,775 Cr, assigning [ICRA]AAA (Stable) to ₹70,000 Cr FY27 LT borrowing programme.
Advances to AP and Telangana accounted for 203% of net worth as of December 31, 2025.
Reversed ₹1,532.86 Cr from Deferred Tax Liability into P&L in Q4FY26.
Resolved 11 NPA agencies under Project Loans during FY26; one fresh slippage of ₹1.15 Cr recorded.
Raised ₹121.12 Cr through maiden 54EC Capital Gain Bonds launched in May 2025.
98.90% of the loan book consists of loans to Govt. and its agencies.
Raised ₹67,503 Cr in FY26 at an average cost of 6.56%.
Interim dividend of ₹4.55 per share already paid for FY26.
98.90% of the FY26 loan book is loans to Government and its agencies; private-sector loans were ₹1,767 Cr.
FY26 borrowings of ₹67,503.22 Cr at 6.56% average cost included ₹5,418.69 Cr of foreign currency loans at 5.96%.
Gross NPA of ₹1,673.84 Cr includes ₹1,060.37 Cr of consortium projects under NCLT, fully provided.
Top 20 exposures accounted for 74.0% of HUDCO's total loan book and 615% of tangible net worth as on December 31, 2025.
HUDCO had sanctioned but undrawn bank lines of ₹11,148.28 Cr as on March 31, 2026.
Existing MOUs total ~₹6.5 lakh Cr; two new MOUs with Gujarat and Bihar each exceed ₹1 lakh Cr
Gross NPA slightly more than ₹1,600 Cr; net NPA around ₹82 Cr
Total repayment for current financial year approx. ₹20,000 Cr; already received ₹4,000 Cr in current quarter
Loan sanctions for H1FY27: ₹1,04,592 Cr (provisional, subject to audit)

timeline.summary: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, disclosed under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) that shares held by the President of India (via Ministry) in HUDCO are unencumbered as of 31/03/2026.
ICRA reaffirmed HUDCO at [ICRA]AAA (Stable)/[ICRA]A1+, assigning AAA to new ₹70,000 Cr FY27 borrowing programme.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,562.86 Cr (+25.2% YoY), net profit ₹1,981.31 Cr (+172.3% YoY).
HUDCO reported record FY26 results with ₹4,034 Cr net profit and outlined a roadmap to a ₹3 lakh Cr balance sheet by FY30.
HUDCO's updated FY26 investor presentation showed loan book up 28.76% to ₹1,60,724 Cr, sanctions up 29% to ₹1,64,758 Cr, GNPA down to 1.04% and net profit of ₹4,034.37 Cr.
CARE assigned AAA/Stable to ₹66,500 Cr proposed bonds and ₹3,500 Cr perpetual debt, and reaffirmed enhanced bank facilities of ₹1,10,000 Cr.
HUDCO reported Q1FY27 results with 35% YoY PAT growth to ₹851 Cr and declared ₹1.25 interim dividend
HUDCO Q1FY27 results: PAT ₹851 Cr; NIM 3.0%; spread 2.0%; and MOUs for ₹2 lakh Cr projects in Gujarat and Bihar
HUDCO's 56th AGM approved a ₹70,000 Cr bond issue and a 15% final dividend.
HUDCO signed an MoU with the Government of Bihar on 2nd September 2026 to provide term loans up to ₹25,000 Cr over five years for industrial infrastructure development.
Japan Credit Rating Agency upgraded HUDCO's long-term issuer ratings from BBB+ to A- with stable outlook on September 3, 2026.
On 22 September 2026, HUDCO reported transfer of promoter shares from Ministry of Rural Development to Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, maintaining 75% government holding.
HUDCO reported loan sanctions of ₹1,04,592 Cr and disbursements of ₹35,371 Cr for the half year ended 30th September 2026.
On 16 October 2026, Moody's affirmed HUDCO's Baa3 issuer and (P)Baa3 MTN program ratings with stable outlook.
Stock exchanges levied a ₹11.72 lakh fine for Q1FY27 board composition non-compliance; HUDCO is seeking a waiver.
